title: The Feather Barbs like a Comb
youtube_title: The Feather Barbs like a Comb | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Wonder grows when you look without grabbing.
summary: At a garden path after a gentle rain, Yuri finds a feather whose barbs zipped shut under a finger. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Yuri shows Leila how to look without disturbing it. Mama looks too, and they leave it where it is.
